morphology.pattern_note: kes 的 e 是 /e/，不是央元音 /ə/。-nya 是与前词连写的后附代词，在这里表示所属或回指语境中的案件、事项。suffix 是本结构对后附形式的归类，并非派生词缀分析。资料包的 کيس 仅对应 kes，完整词形补写 ڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或相关对象的事情、个案或情况；语境中已提及的那件事。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its case, matter, or particular situation; the case already referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Perkara, kejadian atau keadaan tertentu yang berkaitan dengan pihak atau hal yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体指代须依上下文判断；不必涉及犯罪。此处采用资料包中的 kes I，不混入口语 kes II“现金”的同形异义词。释义据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kes) 改写。

collocations.en: his or her case is different

senses.zh_definition: 与他、她或前述事项有关的法律案件或诉讼。
senses.en_definition: His or her legal case, or the legal proceedings already referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Prosiding mahkamah atau perkara undang-undang yang melibatkan pihak yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 可指民事或刑事案件；词形本身不表示当事人有罪。

collocations.en: the trial or hearing of his or her case
his or her case is adjourned

senses.zh_definition: 他、她的病例或病情个案；语境中所指的疾病个案。
senses.en_definition: His or her medical case, or the previously mentioned instance of illness.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian penyakit atau keadaan perubatan bagi pesakit yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 属于 kes“个案、情况”的医疗用法。kesnya 不是病历文件本身；病历通常用 rekod perubatan。

collocations.zh: 其病例转交专科医生处理
collocations.en: his or her case is referred to a specialist
his or her case remains under observation

dual_scenarios.ms: Kesnya akan dibicarakan di Mahkamah Sesyen pada bulan hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他或她的案件将于下个月在地庭审理。
dual_scenarios.en: His or her case will be heard in the Sessions Court next month.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友谈论已知的案件
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kesnya dah selesai ke, atau masih kat mahkamah?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kesnya sudah selesai atau masih dalam proses mahkamah?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他那案子已经结了吗，还是还在走法院程序？
dual_scenarios.en: Has his case been resolved, or is it still going through court?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 表示疑问。
kat mahkamah 是对仍在法院处理的口语概括。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Peguam dia kata kena tunggu bulan depan.
messages.ms_standard: Belum lagi. Peguamnya mengatakan bahawa dia perlu menunggu sehingga bulan hadapan.
messages.zh: 还没。他律师说得等到下个月。
messages.en: Not yet. His lawyer says he'll have to wait until next month.

etymology.historical_story: Kes is an English-origin loan corresponding to case, established in Malay for particular matters, legal proceedings, and instances of illness. Its spelling reflects the Malay form rather than retaining English case. Adding -nya places that borrowed noun inside ordinary Malay grammar: kesnya can identify someone's case or refer back to a case already under discussion. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kes).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kes 连到英语 case，再接 -nya：“他／她的 case”或“前面那一例”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈到他人的案件或病情时，先确保指代明确。法律语境中的 kesnya 只说明存在相关案件，不含定罪判断。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于行政、司法、医疗及日常叙述。面对不熟悉背景的听者，首次提及时用 kes Encik Ahmad 或 kes pesakit tersebut，比直接说 kesnya 清楚。
